products.title: Static Vol. 1 — Vinyl LP
products.description: Our first compilation, pressed on 180-gram black vinyl: twelve tracks from the bands the desk spent the year chasing across basement rooms and festival tents. Gatefold sleeve, liner notes, and a download code inside.
products.seoDescription: The Static Vol. 1 compilation on 180-gram vinyl, twelve tracks with liner notes.

products.title: Static Logo Tee
products.description: The masthead, printed big on the back of a heavyweight black tee. Screen-printed, pre-shrunk, and built to survive the pit and the wash. Runs true to size.
products.seoTitle: Static Logo Tee — heavyweight black t-shirt
products.seoDescription: A heavyweight black tee with the Static masthead screen-printed on the back.

products.title: Static Tour Poster
products.description: An 18×24 screen print in hot crimson on uncoated black stock — the poster from our Vol. 1 launch run. Numbered edition, shipped flat in a rigid tube.
products.seoDescription: A numbered 18×24 screen-printed Static tour poster on black stock.

images.alt: The Static tour poster on a wall

products.title: Static Tote
products.description: A heavyweight canvas tote with the masthead printed small on the side. Carries a stack of records, a notebook, and roughly a festival weekend of essentials.
products.seoDescription: A heavyweight canvas tote with the Static masthead, sized for a stack of records.
